analysis.title: L3Harris Technologies Inc. (LHX): Growth, margin, valuation combination relatively attractive within defense; Buy
key_insights: GS reiterates Buy on LHX with a 12-month price target of $361 (unchanged) against a $277.61 price, 30.0% upside. Rating held since Apr 11, 2025.
3Q26 results were solid: revenue up 9% organically and margins expanded yoy. Total EBIT margin was up 200 bps yoy.
3Q26 GAAP EPS of $3.28 was above FactSet consensus of $2.95 and GS's $2.91 estimate. Adjusted free cash flow was $1,260mn vs consensus of $791mn.
Book-to-bill was 3.2X for the quarter. The company is beginning to book substantial missile volume into backlog.

2026 guidance was raised: revenue $23.5-$23.7bn (from $23.2-$23.7bn), GAAP EPS $12.25-$12.35 (from $11.80-$12.00). Adjusted segment operating margin (low 16%) and free cash flow (~$3.00bn) were reiterated.

The 2028 Investor Day targets were reduced slightly: segment operating margin ~16% (16.3% prior) and free cash flow $3bn+ ($3.5bn prior). GS says this is partly due to definition changes making the numbers cleaner. The 8% organic revenue CAGR is unchanged.
GS sees LHX positioned to capture high-growth areas of the defense budget, with higher than average margins and a lower relative valuation than large-cap defense peers.
Space & Mission Systems revenue of $3.1bn was up 10% yoy, driven by space missile warning and tracking satellite programs, ISR classified programs and international aircraft programs.
Communication & Spectrum Dominance revenue of $2.0bn was up 3% yoy on a higher ramp in counter-UAS programs and international software-defined radios.

GS cut its 2027E FCF/share to $15.44 from $16.24 and its 2028E to $17.30 from $19.20, reflecting revisions to segment revenue and margins. The price target now uses a 4.25% FCF yield on 2027E (4.5% prior).
GS raised its 2026E EPS to $12.29 from $11.95 and cut 2027E to $13.39 from $13.51 and 2028E to $15.30 from $15.48. 2026E revenue rose to $23,645mn from $23,570.7mn.
Stock performance is weak: absolute return of 2.1% over 3m, (13.4)% over 6m and (6.2)% over 12m. Relative to the S&P 500 it is 0.2%, (17.6)% and (15.6)%.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 beat, raised 2026 guidance and growing missile backlog. Multiple is below large-cap defense peers. The target is unchanged although the FCF yield basis moved from 4.5% to 4.25%.

sector_views.rationale: LHX is positioned in high-growth areas of the defense budget, with above-average margins and a lower relative valuation than large-cap defense peers.

earnings_insights: LHX 3Q26 reported GAAP EPS $3.28 vs FactSet consensus est $2.91-$2.95 range: consensus $2.95, GS est $2.91 (reported 3Q26, +33.5% yoy from $2.46).
3Q26 revenue reported $6,060mn vs GS est $5,931mn (+2.2% variance, +7.1% yoy; 9% organic). Total operating profit $786mn vs GS est $711mn (+26.6% yoy).
3Q26 total operating margin 13.0% reported vs GS est 12.0% and 11.0% in 3Q25 (+200 bp yoy). Net interest expense $116mn vs GS est $146mn. Effective tax rate 14.9% vs GS est 15.5%.
3Q26 adjusted free cash flow reported $1,260mn vs consensus est $791mn. Book-to-bill 3.2X.

2026 guidance (company): revenue $23.5-$23.7bn vs consensus est $23.54bn, GAAP EPS $12.25-$12.35 vs consensus est $11.96, adjusted segment operating margin low 16% vs consensus est 16.0%, free cash flow ~$3.00bn vs consensus est $3.03bn.
GS FY estimates: EPS (diluted) 2026E $12.29, 2027E $13.39, 2028E $15.30 vs 2025 actual $8.54. Quarterly EPS estimates: 12/26E $3.16, 3/27E $3.03, 6/27E $3.28.
